detailed_description:
The target video uses a bright, lively, cute nighttime hotel-tour style with warm amber lantern light, rich cinnabar-red accents, clean realistic textures, energetic gimbal tracking, quick pans, playful push-ins, and cuts synchronized to a cheerful rhythm. The pacing stays energetic, with each shot lasting approximately three seconds.

[Shot 1] A high wide shot establishes <Subject 2>, the multi-level lantern-lit courtyard surrounded by grey-brick walls, red pillars, painted beams, balconies, and tiled eaves. <Subject 1> (S1) runs into the center with three quick light steps and opens her arms toward the architecture. The camera pedestals down at fast speed. She looks upward and says brightly, <d>[Chinese] 白天古色古香。</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a medium tracking shot along the corridor. <Subject 1>, preserving the exact same face, jade ornaments, green robe, red skirt, and brown sash, performs one quick playful turn beneath the lanterns. Her sleeves and skirt flare naturally. The camera arcs right at fast speed and she says, <d>[Chinese] 晚上可就不一样啦！</d>

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a close-up beside two glowing lanterns. <Subject 1> points to the first lantern and then the second while counting with an amused expression. The camera pans right with small amplitude at fast speed between the lights. She says, <d>[Chinese] 一盏、两盏。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, the camera cuts to a symmetrical wide shot from the opposite side of the courtyard. <Subject 1> stands at the center and opens both arms toward the surrounding rows of glowing lights. The camera zooms out with large amplitude at fast speed, revealing the full multi-level architecture. She exclaims, <d>[Chinese] 满院灯火！</d>

[Shot 5] At 00:12.000, the shot switches to a playful medium close-up. <Subject 1> leans slightly toward the camera and makes a small elegant picture-frame gesture with her hands. The camera pushes in at fast speed before stopping cleanly on her smile. She says, <d>[Chinese] 随手一拍，都好看！</d>

overall_soundscape:
Quick footsteps on stone, lively fabric movement, faint night wind, gentle lantern creaks, and short camera-transition whooshes accompany the sequence.

non_diegetic_music:
The 118-BPM pipa, bamboo-flute, hand-clap, wooden-percussion, modern-bass, and bell arrangement continues. Lantern reveals and hand gestures are punctuated with short sparkling accents.
